items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: The name 'Bill' appears only as the interviewer addressing the interviewee ('Is that air conditioner getting too cool for you, Bill?'). No other person named Bill is mentioned in the transcript.

ctx.x: We always had a Sears Roebuck catalog around the house. I guess maybe most everybody does. Yeah, imagine those days.
But in those days, oh, the unbelievable bargains that you could get in Sears Roebuck.

Roebuck like a dozen violin E strings for a nickel and I don't know what all a bow for two bits and well anyway they had a they had a something in which turned out to be a damn good cornet for 695 believe it or not I saw it in the catalog so I said that's for me I'm gonna save up and get it so I got 15 cents a week for cleaning up the backyard and I guess I'd get extra money to go to the picture show and things like that well I saved every cop percent I even did without these you know these little penny ice cream…
